launches.name: Nuri | NeonSat-2 to 6
launches.padDetail: 羅老宇宙センター
launches.descriptionEn: NeonSat-2 to 6 are part of the South Korean government's Earth observation micro-satellite constellation NeonSat (New-space Earth Observation Satellite). The NeonSat constellation is the first satellite system developed by the government using a mass-production approach for precise monitoring of the Korean Peninsula.
launches.descriptionJa: NeonSat-2〜6は、韓国政府の地球観測マイクロ衛星コンステレーションNeonSat（New-space Earth Observation Satellite）の一部である。NeonSatコンステレーションは、朝鮮半島の正確な監視のために政府が大量生産アプローチを用いて開発した初の衛星システムである。

launches.name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | SDA Tranche 1 Transport Layer A
launches.padDetail: ヴァンデンバーグ宇宙軍基地 SLC-4E
launches.descriptionEn:
Tranche 1 Transport Layer A is one of six missions by the United States Space Force Space Development Agency (SDA) for the Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture (PWSA) Tranche 1 Transport Layer constellation, which will provide assured, resilient, low-latency military data and connectivity worldwide to the full range of warfighter platforms from Low Earth Orbit satellites.

The constellation will be interconnected with Optical Inter-Satellite Links (OISLs) which have significantly increased performance over existing radio frequency crosslinks. It is expected to operate over Ka band, have stereo coverage and be dynamically networked for simpler hand-offs, greater bandwidth and fault tolerance.

This launch carries 21 satellites manufactured by Northrop Grumman.
launches.descriptionJa:
Tranche 1 Transport Layer Aは、United States Space Force Space Development Agency (SDA)がProlerated Warfighter Space Architecture (PWSA) Tranche 1 Transport Layer衛星群向けに実施する6つのミッションの1つであり、Low Earth Orbit衛星から世界中の各種の戦闘員プラットフォームに対して確実で耐障害性を備えた低遅延の軍事データと通信接続を提供する。

衛星群はOptical Inter-Satellite Links (OISLs)で相互接続され、既存の無線周波数クロスリンクより大幅に性能が向上している。Ka帯で運用され、ステレオカバレッジを有し、より簡単なハンドオフ、より大きな帯域幅、および耐障害性のために動的にネットワーク化されることが期待されている。

本打ち上げはNorthrop Grummanによって製造された21個の衛星を搭載している。

launches.padDetail: ヴァンデンバーグ宇宙軍基地 SLC-4E
launches.descriptionEn: A batch of 27 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
launches.descriptionJa: Starlink巨大衛星群用の27基の衛星のバッチ。これはSpaceXの宇宙ベースのインターネット通信システムプロジェクトである。

launches.name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | Dragon CRS-2 SpX-35
launches.padDetail: ケープカナベラル宇宙軍基地 SLC-40
launches.descriptionEn:
35th commercial resupply services mission to the International Space Station operated by SpaceX. The flight will be conducted under the second Commercial Resupply Services contract with NASA.

Cargo Dragon 2 brings supplies and payloads, including critical materials to directly support science and research investigations that occur onboard the orbiting laboratory.

launches.name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | USSF-xxx ("TH-2")
launches.padDetail: ヴァンデンバーグ宇宙軍基地 SLC-4E
launches.descriptionEn: Classified mission for the United States Space Force. It is possibly a batch of classified LEO satellites based on SpaceX’s Starshield satellite bus, based on locations of ascent rocket stage drop zones being fits with previous SDA Transport Layer launches.

launches.name: H3-24 | Martian Moon eXplorer (MMX)
launches.padDetail: 種子島宇宙センター 吉信射点
launches.descriptionEn:
MMX is a Japanese scientific mission to land on Phobos, one of the two moons of Mars, to collect samples before bringing them back to Earth.

The mission includes a small French/German rover to explore the surface of Phobos.
launches.descriptionJa:
MMXは、火星の2つの衛星の1つであるPhobosに着陸し、サンプルを採集してから地球に持ち帰るための日本の科学ミッションです。

このミッションには、Phobosの表面を探査するためのフランス/ドイツの小型ローバーが含まれています。

launches.name: Ariane 64 Block 2 | Amazon Leo (LE-04)
launches.padDetail: クールー宇宙センター ELA-4
launches.descriptionEn:
Amazon Leo, formerly known as Project Kuiper, is a mega constellation of satellites in Low Earth Orbit that will offer broadband internet access, this constellation will be managed by Kuiper Systems LLC, a subsidiary of Amazon. This constellation is planned to be composed of 3,276 satellites. The satellites are projected to be placed in 98 orbital planes in three orbital layers, one at 590 km, 610 km and 630 km altitude.

35-40 satellites will be carried on each Ariane 6 launch.

launches.name: GSLV Mk II | IRNSS-1L (NVS-03)
launches.padDetail: サティッシュ・ダワン宇宙センター 第2射点
launches.descriptionEn: This is a replacement satellite for the Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System. The constellation will provide India with an alternative to GPS and will be used for military and civilian use. Located at a geosynchronous orbit, the system will be operated by the Indian government.
launches.descriptionJa: これはIndian Regional Navigation Satellite Systemの代替衛星です。このコンステレーションはインドにGPSの代替手段を提供し、軍事および民間用途に使用されます。静止軌道に位置するこのシステムはインド政府によって運用されます。

launches.name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | Cygnus CRS-2 NG-25
launches.padDetail: ケープカナベラル宇宙軍基地 SLC-40
launches.descriptionEn: This is the 25th flight of the Orbital ATK's uncrewed resupply spacecraft Cygnus and its 24th flight to the International Space Station under the Commercial Resupply Services contract with NASA.

launches.padDetail: サティッシュ・ダワン宇宙センター 第2射点
launches.descriptionEn: First uncrewed orbital test flight of the Gaganyaan capsule.

launches.name: PSLV-XL | TDS-01
launches.padDetail: サティッシュ・ダワン宇宙センター 第1射点
launches.descriptionEn:
TDS-01 (Technology Demonstration Satellite-01) is an Indian geostationary orbit technology demonstration satellite carrying payloads for the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)’s Institute of Plasma Research, Gandhinagar and the CSIR-CEERI, Pilani. 

Payloads to be tested included an internally developed 300 mN electric powered thrusters, atomic clocks, travelling wave tube amplifiers (TWTA) & a quantum communication suite (QuTDS).

launches.name: Atlas V N22 | Starliner-1
launches.provider: ULA（ユナイテッド・ローンチ・アライアンス）
launches.padDetail: ケープカナベラル宇宙軍基地 SLC-41
launches.descriptionEn: Starliner-1 is the first operational flight of a Starliner spacecraft to the International Space Station as part of NASA's Commercial Crew Program. Due to problems with the Starliner spacecraft's RCS attitude control system during the Crew Flight Test mission in 2024, this mission has been re-scoped to not carry a crew by NASA. It will instead deliver necessary cargo to the orbital laboratory and allow in-flight validation of the system upgrades implemented following the Crew Flight Test mission.

launches.name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | SDA Tranche 2 Transport Layer D

launches.descriptionEn: Classified mission launched by the Space Development Agency (SDA) for Tranche 2 Transport Layer.

launches.name: Falcon Heavy | Griffin Mission One
launches.padDetail: ケネディ宇宙センター LC-39A
launches.descriptionEn: Demonstration flight of the Astrobotic Griffin lander and its engines, initially contracted for the cancelled NASA VIPER (Volatiles Investigating Polar Exploration Rover) mission. The vacated payload spot will now host the FLIP (FLEX Lunar Innovation Platform) lunar rover from Astrolab.
